description: Implementation of a Tun/Tap network device interface for Linux, including device initialization, configuration, and control functions.

classes.name: TunTapDevice
classes.description: A class managing a Linux TUN/TAP device, providing methods to initialize, configure, bring up/down, and close the device.

methods.name: TunTapDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TUN/TAP device with specified parameters.

methods.name: ~TunTapDevice
methods.description: Destructor that disables the device if not persistent and closes the device.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the device by opening and configuring it.

methods.name: GetFileDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the device.

methods.name: OpenDevice
methods.description: Opens the TUN/TAP device and sets necessary flags.

methods.name: ConfigureInterface
methods.description: Configures the network interface, e.g., setting MTU.

methods.name: NetdeviceIoctl
methods.description: Performs ioctl operations on the device.
